title: Stoke Space
description: Launch-pad black: a pure black page with one off-white ink, light-weight Inter for every word of copy, an extra-wide heavy all-caps grotesk for headings, and three neon accents (orange, magenta, violet) used only as glowing hairlines and a rising gradient. Square media, 4px corners on the few panels, 10px page gutters on desktop.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a sibling (off-white page, black ink, the same three accents a little deeper)
Archivo Variable at font-stretch 125% stands in for Druk Wide (closed); Inter Variable with its optical-size axis for Inter Display
sets two theme-only vars the stokespace blocks read: --stokespace-stretch (125%) and --stokespace-widen (0.05em extra heading tracking)
page gutter narrows from 1.25rem to 0.625rem and section spacing grows from 2.1875rem to 4.375rem at 1024px
name: stokespace-theme
